say:3:1421819001:1.text: Terrific! All the plants have been revived!
say:3:1421819001:1.source_cn: 好神奇！枯萎消失了……这里的生机恢复了！

say:4:1421819002:1.text: We can finally be at ease now!

say:5:1421819003:1.text: This plant can really do wonders...
say:5:1421819003:1.source_cn: 原来这种植物真的有这样神奇的作用……

say:6:1421819004:1.text: I thought I knew everything about plants, but it turns out I still have so much to learn.
say:6:1421819004:1.source_cn: 我本以为自己对于这些已经知道得够多了，原来还有太多我不...

say:7:1421819005:1.text: Looks like you know a lot about the subterranean ecosystem.
say:7:1421819005:1.source_cn: 看样子你对地底的生态很了解？

say:8:1421819006:1.text: You bet! I know the names and properties of every plant and mushroom here—they're my friends!
say:8:1421819006:1.source_cn: 那当然！这里每种植物和蕈菇的名字和习性我都知道，它们都...

say:9:1421819007:1.text: This job as a florist apprentice is helping me master the art of caring for plants.
say:9:1421819007:1.source_cn: 我现在在花店当学徒，也是为了学习照顾它们的知识，培育更...

say:10:1421819008:1.text: Could I take another look at the book? Those beautiful plants and mushrooms are fascinating...
say:10:1421819008:1.source_cn: 我还有一件事想拜托你们……我可以再看看这本书吗……我想...

say:11:1421819009:1.text: You can have it! I've already memorized everything inside anyway. But before I give it to you, I have one question.
say:11:1421819009:1.source_cn: 我可以把这本书送给你！反正里面的内容我已经背下来了。前...

say:12:1421819010:1.text: Seems like he still hasn't given up...

say:13:1421819011:1.text: W—What is it? I can tell you everything I know about the ecosystem here...
say:13:1421819011:1.source_cn: 什、什么问题？如果你们对这里的生态感兴趣，我知无不言……

say:14:1421819012:1.text: Do the giant mushrooms and the mushroom sprites share a special relationship? Like... could the mushrooms eventually turn into the mushroom sprites??
say:14:1421819012:1.source_cn: 这里的巨蕈和菇灵间是不是有某种奇妙的联系？比如说……一...

say:15:1421819013:1.text: Please tell me polymorphism exists here! Verifying this theory is exactly why I used the quickgrow potion in the first place...
say:15:1421819013:1.source_cn: “生物在不同阶段的多态性”……验证我的伟大猜想吧！这才...

say:16:1421819014:1.text: What you say will determine if I can start working on my book!
say:16:1421819014:1.source_cn: 我的《古国巨蕈形态考》正在未来向我招手！

say:17:1421819015:1.text: Huh? That's a bizarre idea... I know you're hoping for a positive answer, but I'm sorry to say there's no such thing.
say:17:1421819015:1.source_cn: 啊？这是什么奇怪的猜想……很遗憾，虽然你这样迫切地看着...

say:18:1421819016:1.text: They just look alike, that's all.
say:18:1421819016:1.source_cn: 它们只是长得有点相似而已。

say:19:1421819017:1.text: Ah... My book! This is so disappointing.
say:19:1421819017:1.source_cn: 啊……这……我的《古国巨蕈形态考》……

say:20:1421819018:1.text: This is yet another failed expedition, but one I won't forget...
say:20:1421819018:1.source_cn: 又是一次难忘的失败考察呢……
